newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BELGIUM HAVE NO ANSWER TO NORTHERN IRELAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BELGIUM HAVE NO ANSWER TO NORTHERN IRELAND.

text.p: Belgium suffered an embarrassing 3-0 defeat by Northern Ireland in a friendly on Tuesday.

Jimmy Quinn fired Northern Ireland ahead in the 14th minute and the scoreline remained that way until midway through the second half when Jim Magilton converted a penalty after a foul on Philip Mulryne. Mulryne headed the third goal two minutes from time to complete an impressive debut.
The victory boosted Northern Ireland's confidence ahead of their home World Cup qualifier against European group nine leaders Portugal on March 29.
Belgium visit Wales for a group seven game the same day.
